caption: The drawing depicts the front facade of a building rendered in grey pencil on a plain, light-colored background. The structure is symmetrical and composed of two main stories topped by a triangular pediment. Four large columns run vertically along the lower level, supporting an entablature beneath the upper story. The central section features a large arched doorway framed by two columns, with two wide steps at its base. The upper story contains several rectangular and arched windows framed by additional columns and pilasters. Shaded areas suggest depth and the thickness of the walls. Beneath the main structure, there is a ribbon-like banner that bears the text "1776, MISION SAN FRANCISCO DE ASIS" written in capital letters, with the year on a separate, shaded tooltip-like segment to the left of the rest of the text. The entire drawing is monochromatic, relying on variations in shading and line thickness for detail, structure, and shadow.
title: Mision San Francisco de Asis
